gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reads tall and squared-off, its terminals stopping well short of the stems. Anek Kannada's partner Conthrax earns its place big and brief, where its wide-mouthed a and strokes with no thick or thin can stand alone.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-latin: Professional in tone, Anek Latin lifts its lowercase nearly to capital height and keeps its letters held open. Conthrax sits above with a marker-like, steady line, so text underneath feels like following one clear thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-tamil: Modern and round, Conthrax stands over wire-cut strokes. Anek Tamil adds big lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes, which keep the text moving without a snag.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Approachable but oddly stern, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono clips its capitals and ascenders beside the lowercase, with stencil-bridge spacing stretched wide. Conthrax adds pen-pressure sameness.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next has lowercase eyes as big as washers, rounds left unlatched. Beneath Conthrax, with its plain constant-width lines, the text feels like one continuous thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic brings a high x-height and an generous opening in c. Under Conthrax, whose curves never shift in weight, the text moves in one smooth, unbroken line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-chivo: Conthrax bends its lines like rope or tubing, wide-mouthed in the a. Chivo follows with lowercase packed up toward the caps and daylight through every curve, so paragraphs move smoothly.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-gidole: Gidole reads with a high midline and terminals that stay apart like open scissor blades. Gidole's neon-tube consistency runs under Conthrax, so paragraphs carry along like a single thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Hedvig Letters Sans leaves a wide gap where the c ends, and its small letters stand nearly as tall as capitals. And Conthrax, drawn in a single-width stroke, makes paragraphs feel like one thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-heebo: Neutral in manner, Heebo gives a tall central band of text and curves that stop short instead of closing in. Its steady stroke against Conthrax is the strength.
